The '''Last Stand at Refnar''' was a military engagement between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Alliance were forced to evacuate their [[Unidentified Alliance base (Refnar)|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Refnar]].<ref name="CRO" />
